task: Two full-body humanoid robots cooperatively fold one rectangular quilt on a residential laundry table.

phase_plan.instruction: Hold the supplied frame exactly. Both robots and every quilt point remain still.
Both robots approach their two assigned quilt corners without moving cloth, then visibly close all four hands on the bound corners.
The robots synchronously lift the viewer-near corners while stabilizing the far corners and rotate the complete near half over the far half as one connected quilt.
Hold the half-folded quilt supported and motionless before any regrasp.
Regrasp the new viewer-left and viewer-right outer corners without disturbing the settled first fold.
The viewer-left robot folds the left third inward while the viewer-right robot folds the right third inward with synchronized, contact-driven motion.
Both robots gently square the compact layered rectangle, place it fully on the table, open their hands, and withdraw without cloth drift.
Hold one compact folded quilt completely still and keep both robots visible.

decision_policy.visual_acceptance: All visual_hard_gates must be PASS; FAIL or UNAVAILABLE rejects. No aggregate score may override a gate.
decision_policy.physical_promotion: All visual and physical_promotion_gates must be PASS. Generated RGB alone cannot satisfy a physical gate.
decision_policy.selection: Evaluate every seed independently, discard any failed candidate, then compare visual quality only among candidates that pass every prior gate.

claim_boundary: MiniMax-H3 outputs are generated camera-pixel proposals depicting full-body humanoid cooperation. They are not recorded real-hardware execution and cannot be promoted to physical PASS without the declared physical evidence.
